description: Allow cross-domain requests by override Origin and CORS headers. Log/capture XmlHttpRequest API calls for debugging and analytics.
name: Moesif Origin/CORS Changer & API Logger

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://api.moesif.net;  style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:;
